==About==

A Monk's Pan can be found in the wild or, with the [[Fungiculture]] skill learned, grown by planting another {{i|Monk's Pan}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When planting a Monk's Pan there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Monk's Pan can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}.
